# Summary

The charter states that each member pays a yearly contribution. The amount of this contribution is fixed in the annex of the charter[[cite:obs-c437c9275c01d708a05000dafa1b12b01de0feb5 "Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter."]]. The annex specifies that the ordinary contribution is one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January[[cite:obs-445487fa2aaa51df93b8451f585756b99d46c8ca "Ordinary contributions: one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January."]].
